$comment: WorkBuddy host runtime file-read denylist. The host LLM must never Read, cat, or echo the contents of files matching these patterns. This is a machine-readable contract for the WorkBuddy runtime; it must be enforced by the host's file-access layer, not by the LLM prompt.
$allow_note: ranking-overview.html and per-candidate <appno>.html are safe for the host UI to open in a browser panel; they contain refno/appno labels only, no names or PII. The host LLM must still not Read their raw HTML into the model context.
